decisions.reason: The coffee-based men's series is a standalone niche line whose value is still uncertain, and there is no evidence after 2019 that it has failed, so keeping this cheap option open is reasonable for now, though it carries more holding cost and risk than a line extension.

The cleansing foam extends the established Sandorini series, so it costs little to keep, shares production and marketing with the core line, and has shown no negative signal that would justify dropping it.
